Definition: adverb from G4984; corporeally or physically:--bodily.
BiblicalUsage: In Him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily. The whole of God, not a part of Him, lives in Christ in a real body.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse answers every claim that Jesus was only a spirit or only a man: God dwelt in Him bodily, and that is why He can save.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
